File Information
Collection: DDT_HotelBooking
Environment: DDT_Hotel_Booking
Collection Description
This collection is designed to test the Hotel Booking API through a complete booking lifecycle using data-driven values stored in environment variables. It includes requests to: - retrieve booking IDs - create a new booking - generate an authentication token - fully update an existing booking - partially update an existing booking - delete a booking - verify the results of create, update, partial update, and delete operations with follow-up GET requests The collection is structured to support end-to-end API validation by reusing dynamic values such as `{{base_url}}`, `{{My_Booking}}`, and other booking-related variables from the active environment.
